Title: Upload failure handling and resume
Description: As a desktop user, I want to recover from upload failures without losing my work so that I can retry without re-extracting. If POST /batches/knowledge fails, the app shows the failure, keeps knowledge in the local SQLite cache, and allows retry or resume without calling the AI provider again.
AcceptanceCriteria: Upload client detects and displays failure messages
Knowledge items remain in local cache on failure
User can click Retry to re-upload without re-extraction
Retry uses the same Idempotency-Key for deduplication
Resume workflow allows uploading deselected items if desired
History screen shows failed batches with error message and retry button
No AI calls occur during retry; only POST /collector/batches/knowledge is retried
End-to-end check: force failure during upload, restart service, verify retry succeeds
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Handling upload failures gracefully by keeping knowledge in the local cache and allowing retry without re-extraction. Idempotency-Key prevents duplicates on retry. Users can resume upload with the same or modified selection.

Steps.Action: Load a folder, extract knowledge, and begin upload
Stop the entire stack: pwsh -NoProfile -File Cortexa-dev/deploy/local/native/run-local.ps1 stop
Steps.Expected: All services stop; active upload fails

Steps.Action: Desktop shows failure message; click Retry
Steps.Expected: Retry is blocked (services down); knowledge is cached

Steps.Action: Start the stack again: pwsh -NoProfile -File Cortexa-dev/deploy/local/native/run-local.ps1 start
Click Retry in the History screen
